summary.name: Better Analyst
summary.one_liner: Better Analyst (formerly Formula Bot) is an AI data analyst that answers plain-English questions over connected data sources and produces charts, dashboards and scheduled reports.
use_cases: analyze GA4 and marketing data with plain-English questions
build live dashboards and scheduled reports
get email or Slack alerts when a metric changes
query SQL databases and warehouses without writing code
separate data per client in agency work
summary.what_it_does: Better Analyst lets you connect data sources such as GA4, Google Search Console, Google Ads, spreadsheets, uploaded Excel/CSV/TSV/PDF files, and databases including PostgreSQL, MySQL, BigQuery and Snowflake. You ask questions in plain English and it returns charts, insights, spreadsheets and data models. It shows the calculations and code behind complex transformations so outputs can be checked. Dashboards can refresh on a schedule, and alerts send email when a metric crosses a threshold, changes sharply, or stops arriving. Owners control which tables, columns and rows the AI can read.
notable: Connects to a wide range of sources including GA4, Search Console, Google Ads, Tableau, Power BI, HubSpot, Salesforce and major SQL warehouses
Shows calculations and code behind transformations so results can be verified
Projects keep each client's sources, chats, dashboards and alerts separate
Alerts can be previewed against the last 30, 60 or 90 days before saving
caveats: Several key features (team sharing, Projects, Slack alerts, SSO, SCIM, audit log, white-label embeds) are restricted to the Team or Enterprise plans
Refunds only within 30 days of the latest payment and under 50 billable messages or requests since that payment
Accuracy depends on data quality and question clarity
